title: Astro Portal API v1 what is online for a night
description: GET /v1/sessions/{id}/online: what is already in the space for one night, read by Astro Sync's resume and its « Nuits » list before anything is sent, and later by the phone. Per target of the night (the night's targets first, in their order — its own or its plan's —, then the targets only a capture names, then the captures with no target under `targetId: null`): its captures, each with its source, stage, visibility, its main image and every image (the main one first, then the variants), each image with its SHA-256 (an identical image is never sent again), and the files attached to the capture (`attachments`, the linear file) with theirs and whether a sky solution exists for it (the solution belongs to each image, sky-solution.schema.json). And for the night, the analysis in place (one per night, the next sending replaces it). By a device token of the space or the owner's web session; never gated by a capability; another space's night is 404 `session_not_found`, a caller without credentials 401.

attachment.description: One file attached to a capture: its role (`linear`), digest, size, the name it was sent with and its date.

source.description: Where an image came from (capture-variant.schema.json): `phone`, `web`, `astro-sync`, `stacking`; null for an image stored before the images had a source. A capture's source is its main image's.

image.description: One image of a capture: `main` for the main image; its digest, size, the name it was sent with, its date, and `skySolution`: `present` when a sky solution is stored for this image, `missing` otherwise.

capture.description: A capture of the night (`captures.session_id`): its targets, source, stage (`draft` from a device until finalized), visibility, `uploaded` (its bytes are all in), the main image (null only for a capture whose image row is missing) and the number of images with each of them.

generatedTitle.description: The title the service generates for a capture of a series, by language (« M45 · 429 × 30 s · 3 h 34 »): the target's name, the frames, one frame's exposure and the total. Kept apart from the owner's title, which takes its place when written.

targetMain.description: Present on every capture of a target that has a capture of a series: whether it is the main capture of the target. The main capture of a target is always listed first, so a reader that takes the first capture (Astro Sync 1.0.3 and before) adds its images to it.

attachments.description: The files attached to the capture (capture-attachment.schema.json: the linear file of « Sans traitement »), never among `images` nor counted in `imageCount`; each with its SHA-256, so that an identical file is never sent again. Absent on an answer written before the files existed; a reader assumes `[]`.

target.description: One target of the night: `planned` when it is one of the night's own or its plan's targets; `name`, its designation (null for an identifier the space no longer knows).

analysis.description: The night's analysis in place: when it was sent and by which device (`deviceName` null when the device is gone), its report version and producer, `stepCount` the night's steps it proposed (origin `analysis` or `import`) and `editedStepCount` those corrected by hand. `present: false` and the rest null or zero without an analysis.
